messages:
Diego V: Hey team My corporate card was charged for minibar incidentals at the hotel (I didn't use it). Charge on statement: 45.90 EUR. Can we reverse this or should I submit an expense?
Expense Bot: Please upload the corpcard statement snippet and any hotel folio you have. Policy: https://redwood.example/policies/expenses (see corpcard disputes).
Diego V: Uploaded statement screenshot: https://imgur.com/minibar-charge and the hotel folio shows a single room rate + 'incidentals' line but no signature: https://hotel.example/folio/folio123.pdf
Lexi (Finance): Thanks Diego. Two options: (1) we open a merchant inquiry to dispute the corpcard charge (preferred if cardholder did not authorize); or (2) if hotel confirms the incidental was charged by hotel policy and you agree it was valid, we can reclassify. Since you say you did NOT use minibar, we will open a dispute. We need manager confirmation to proceed.
Diego V: @Maya can you confirm Diego was onsite but did not use minibar?
Maya (Manager): Confirmed Diego was in the room but did not use minibar. I approve Finance to open a dispute for 45.90 EUR.
Lexi (Finance): Opening merchant inquiry now. Note on FX: the card posted as USD equivalent 50.12 USD. We will file dispute in original currency (EUR) and track both amounts. If dispute resolves in our favor, we'll reverse the posted USD. If not, we'll reimburse you if it's a personal charge; since you didn't use it, good chance dispute will win.
Expense Bot: Dispute ticket created (DISP-2026-0022). Please keep original receipts if hotel follows up.
Diego V: Thanks I'll follow up with the hotel if they request confirmation. Appreciate it.
Lexi (Finance): We'll update this thread when dispute status changes. If the merchant rejects, we'll either post a personal chargeback or reimburse depending on final determination.
Expense Bot: Dispute status: OPEN.
